skills.name: Promo code summary
skills.description: Summarize orders that used a given promo code over the last 30 days.

skills.name: Monthly close report
skills.description: Generate a one-page financial summary for the most recently completed calendar month.

skills.name: Top customers by lifetime value
skills.description: Rank customers by lifetime order revenue. Useful for VIP outreach.

skills.name: Scrape a URL into the active theme
skills.description: Fetch a page, extract its layout and copy, scaffold a matching Fluid theme section.

skills.name: Theme accessibility audit
skills.description: Scan the active theme for common a11y issues and propose fixes.

skills.name: Optimize theme images
skills.description: Add responsive, lazy-loaded images and videos to Fluid Liquid themes with the media_tag filter (srcset/sizes/width/height/loading) and ImageKit transforms.

skills.name: Theme review & fix
skills.description: Iteratively review and fix a Fluid theme one section at a time: schema, Liquid correctness, performance, a11y, and DRY.

skills.name: Translate theme languages
skills.description: Translate a Fluid theme into every language the company has enabled, syncing locales/*.json with professional, on-brand localization.

skills.name: Scaffold a new Droplet for a Mist
skills.description: Set up the Droplet UI scaffolding (page, route, schema) for a fresh Mist app.

skills.name: Audit env vars across all live Mists
skills.description: Check every live Mist for missing or inconsistent env vars (Stripe keys, webhook secrets, etc.).

skills.name: Debug a failed Mist deploy
skills.description: Pull deployment logs, identify the failure, and propose a fix.

skills.name: Theme Clone
skills.description: Clone any website into a pixel-perfect Fluid theme — scrape the source, build sections, push, and visually verify against the original.

skills.name: Theme Refine
skills.description: Refine a Fluid theme to the gold standard: pixel-perfect visual QA after a clone, or migrate a legacy theme to the canonical architecture.

skills.name: Onboarding Pre-Fill
skills.description: Pre-fill the Fluid payments onboarding (KYC) form by scraping the company website and researching public records, with confidence scoring before pushing.

skills.name: TikTok UGC Discovery
skills.description: Find the 20-30 most engaging, FTC/FDA-compliant TikTok UGC videos about a brand or product, let the user pick, and pull the picks into the DAM.

skills.name: Brand Social Content Import
skills.description: Import a company's OWN YouTube + TikTok videos into Fluid: find the official accounts, register them in social-media settings, and pull their videos into the DAM + Media. Not UGC — this is the brand's own content.

skills.name: Brand Setup
skills.description: Interview the company to build a living brand.md — a brand-voice document that Mist, themes, portals, and widgets read to match the company's tone and style. Prefills colors/name from brand guidelines and saves via the update_brand_voice tool. Also use to append a single brand decision later.

skills.name: Promo margin exposure audit
skills.description: Rank active promo codes by usage and discount depth to flag margin-eroding codes and dead codes before the next planning cycle.

skills.name: Shareable content leaderboard
skills.description: Rank media and enrollment-pack shareables by shares, unique sharers, and visits-per-share to find what's actually converting, not just getting shared.

skills.name: UGC product gap analysis
skills.description: Cross-reference best-selling products against the existing media/UGC library to find best-sellers with no social proof — the highest-leverage gaps to fill next.

skills.name: Order attribution mix
skills.description: See which touch model (first-touch rep, last-touch rep, enrollment rep) is actually driving completed orders, to know which channel/relationship investment to double down on.

skills.name: Suggested Changes
skills.description: Review Lighthouse performance and compliance findings for this store, then approve or dismiss each recommended fix — approvals are applied and their impact is tracked.

skills.name: Open a Country
skills.description: Guided company-launch flow powered by Fluid's Country Atlas: pick the operating mode (NFR / OTG / USD), branch into mode-specific setup (operations status, entity, business id, warehouse), pick payment methods, missing languages, agreements, and enrollment fields, then run the open-country workflow with QA and chain the mode finalizer.

skills.name: Country Compliance Manager
skills.description: Audit a storefront against a country's legal requirements — disclosure pages, price display, cookie/privacy law, agreements, product labeling, storefront language — using the Country Atlas as the rulebook. Runs standalone and as the final step of the mode finalizers.

skills.name: Onboard & Launch Company
skills.description: Guided end-to-end company onboarding: collect the website URL, auto-detect available Connect integrations (Shopify / Exigo / ByDesign droplets) or fall back to public scraping, then fire the flagship onboard-launch-company workflow — clone the site, iteratively refine the theme against screenshots, import products, tick off Getting Started, discover UGC, and deliver a launch-readiness review.

skills.name: Iterative Theme Refine
skills.description: Screenshot-based iterative refinement loop that runs after theme-clone: each round captures paired screenshots (source vs cloned preview), fixes the top 1-3 discrepancies, and re-checks — capped at 5 iterations with a documented remaining-diff report if the cap is hit.
